datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: White-tailed deer hunting activity and harvest
datasets.spatialResolution: Ontario Wildlife Management Unit
datasets.limitations: Harvest and active-hunter counts are estimates from a sample of resident hunter reports and are subject to statistical error. They are historical WMU evidence, not current animal presence or hunting legality.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources, Office of the Surveyor General
datasets.title: Crown land: ministry unpatented land
datasets.spatialResolution: Parcel-like polygons for ministry-managed Crown land and land under water
datasets.temporalCoverage: Current as published; updated as required
datasets.licence: Open Government Licence – Ontario, with some additional OGDE-only features
datasets.limitations: The catalogue says the dataset is for planning and mapping only, is not a legal parcel boundary, and includes additional OGDE-only features. Service schema and a reliable way to exclude non-redistributable features must be certified before storage or display. Ownership does not establish access or permission to hunt.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: Crown land use policy area (provincial)
datasets.spatialResolution: Provincial land-use policy areas
datasets.limitations: The authority explicitly says this land-use policy layer must not be used as a source of Crown land, private land, parks, or conservation-reserve boundaries. It cannot power the Crown Land layer.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: Chronic wasting disease surveillance in members of the deer family
datasets.spatialResolution: Sample records; exact reusable spatial fields require schema review
datasets.limitations: Surveillance locations vary by year and are selected by risk. A sample record is not a confirmed detection area, a mandatory-testing area, or a carcass-transport restriction. Terms and fields require review before mapping.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: In-year Fire Perimeters
datasets.spatialResolution: Fire perimeter polygons
datasets.limitations: A fire perimeter or danger rating is a condition, not a legal access or hunting closure. Closure orders require a separate authoritative source and model.

datasets.authority: British Columbia Ministry of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship, Wildlife and Habitat Branch
datasets.title: Big Game Harvest Statistics 1976 to 2024
datasets.spatialResolution: British Columbia Management Unit, with region and province rollup rows that are not units
datasets.temporalCoverage: Hunt years 1976–2024; evidence built from 2024, the latest year published
datasets.limitations: Carries resident and non-resident hunters, hunter days and kills separately, so harvest, effort and success stay separate components and success is never derived beyond the authority's own denominators. Region (R99) and province (999) rows are rollups, not units, and are excluded. Harvest is evidence of past reported outcomes, never a claim that animals are present now, and never a statement about legality. Cougar, mountain goat, mountain sheep and grizzly bear are published in the same file but North Ground holds no canonical species record for them, so no evidence is built; grizzly hunting has been closed in British Columbia since 2017. Regional rollup codes (100–900, and 770/780 for regions 7A Omineca and 7B Peace) are totals, not units, and carry no evidence.

datasets.authority: British Columbia Ministry of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship, Wildlife and Habitat Branch
datasets.title: Hunter Sample Survey Estimates 1976 to 2024 (excluded)
datasets.spatialResolution: British Columbia Management Unit
datasets.limitations: Excluded deliberately and permanently unless written permission is obtained. The catalogue marks it Access Only: "reproduction is not permitted without written permission" and "It may not be reproduced or redistributed without the prior written permission of the Province of British Columbia." It would add 95% confidence bounds to the same programme's figures, which is why someone will be tempted; it is not to be read, cached or cross-checked against. The OGL-BC Big Game Harvest Statistics file carries the usable output.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: Ontario moose hunting activity and harvest
datasets.spatialResolution: Ontario Wildlife Management Unit
datasets.limitations: Active hunters are published, so effort is its own component and success is derived only from the authority's own denominator. The authority says its figures are estimates from a sample of resident hunters, subject to statistical error. Files are cp1252, not UTF-8, and a suppressed cell ("...") is no-data, never zero. Codes are zero-padded where the Wildlife Management Unit layer is not, so ids are minted from the layer's designation. Harvest is evidence of past reported outcomes, not presence and not legality.

datasets.authority: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources
datasets.title: Ontario elk harvests (held back)
datasets.spatialResolution: Elk Harvest Area (9 areas), which is NOT the Wildlife Management Unit geography
datasets.limitations: Openly licensed and usable, but reported by Elk Harvest Area (57-01 to 63-08), a geography North Ground does not hold or certify. Mapping it onto Wildlife Management Units would invent a boundary the authority did not publish. Held back until the Elk Harvest Area geography is ingested and parity-certified; not a licence problem.

datasets.authority: Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs
datasets.title: Statistiques historiques de chasse au Québec — moose
datasets.spatialResolution: Zone de chasse (30 zones in the file); codes match North Ground's certified Québec zone designations
datasets.limitations: No hunter count is published, so Québec evidence is harvest volume only: no effort component and no success rate, derived or otherwise. The ministry states the zone names and boundaries have changed over time and that it re-mapped historical harvest onto today's zones, so an older record's geography is the ministry's reconstruction; that warning rides on every affected record. Files are cp1252, not UTF-8. Harvest is broken down by sex, age class and weapon, which is evidence about past reported outcomes, never presence and never legality.

datasets.authority: Manitoba Department of Natural Resources and Indigenous Futures, Fish and Wildlife Branch
datasets.title: Manitoba per-Game-Hunting-Area harvest evidence (none published)
datasets.spatialResolution: None published at Game Hunting Area resolution
datasets.licence: OpenMB Information and Data Use Licence
datasets.limitations: NO HEAT-MAP DATA, not PARTIAL. Manitoba's licence is permissive and its geoportal is searchable, but it publishes no harvest, effort, success or population dataset at Game Hunting Area resolution in any machine-readable form. The big-game survey PDFs cover a handful of GHAs per year under a methodology that changed mid-series, and the wild turkey harvest split is published only as a pie chart, which is not a value. A hunter harvest survey is collected but no results are published. Manitoba's web server answers 200 with HTML for missing files, so any future fetcher must gate on content-type, never on status.

datasets.authority: New Brunswick Department of Natural Resources and Energy Development, Fish and Wildlife Branch
datasets.title: Big Game Harvest Reports
datasets.spatialResolution: Wildlife Management Zone (27)
datasets.licence: None stated; © Government of New Brunswick
datasets.limitations: Registered deer and moose harvest per Wildlife Management Zone, plus moose sightings per hour hunted by zone 1990–2024, which is the most defensible effort-standardised index found in Canada. The PDFs carry no licence and the provincial disclaimer states no reproduction terms, so commercial use is unresolved. The Wildlife Management Zone geometry is separately open under the New Brunswick Open Government Licence; the harvest numbers are not. Letter drafted for the owner to send.

datasets.authority: Nova Scotia Department of Natural Resources and Renewables
datasets.title: Deer and moose harvest statistics
datasets.spatialResolution: Deer Management Zone; moose success rate by zone
datasets.temporalCoverage: Zone-level deer 2018–2024; moose success by zone 2019–2023
datasets.licence: Crown copyright, Government of Nova Scotia; no open licence on these pages
datasets.limitations: Per-zone deer harvest appears in the 2022, 2023 and 2024 editions and was DROPPED from the 2025 edition, which is province-wide only. Any pipeline must pin the edition and its hash rather than follow "latest", or it silently loses all zone resolution. Nova Scotia's only openly licensed wildlife data is its bear extracts, which are county-level and therefore the wrong geography for a zone map. Letter drafted for the owner to send.

datasets.authority: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador
datasets.title: Hunting and Trapping Guide quota and success tables, and per-area survey tables
datasets.spatialResolution: Moose Management Area and Caribou Management Area, the geographies North Ground already holds
datasets.temporalCoverage: Quota and success for 2024; per-area survey tables 2006, 2012, 2018; hunter statistics 2017–2021
datasets.licence: None named; Crown copyright with permission extended to public and non-government organizations
datasets.limitations: The richest per-area evidence in Atlantic Canada: quota, overall success rate, winter survey density, recruitment, hunter days and animals seen per day, all keyed to management areas North Ground already holds. The disclaimer names no licence and does not address commercial use, and it prohibits reproduction of embedded third-party material. One page mixes vintages: 2022 survey tables beside 2024 success rates, so each record must carry its own effective period rather than the page's. Letter drafted for the owner to send.

datasets.authority: Saskatchewan Ministry of Environment
datasets.title: Hunter Harvest Survey Results
datasets.spatialResolution: Wildlife Management Zone for draw and big-game-management licences only; ordinary resident licences are reported province-wide
datasets.limitations: Blocked on two counts. The site-wide Crown copyright requires advance written permission for commercial use, and coverage is thin: the highest-volume regular-licence harvest, including resident white-tailed deer, is published province-wide with no zone breakdown. Saskatchewan's zone geometry is separately open. Letter drafted for the owner to send, paired with the existing zone-layer reuse question.

datasets.authority: Government of Yukon, Department of Environment
datasets.title: Per-subzone harvest evidence (not published)
datasets.spatialResolution: No per-Game-Management-Subzone harvest dataset located
datasets.limitations: Yukon's licence is open and its subzone geometry is already held, but no per-subzone harvest dataset was found published. The territory's own catalogue says the harvest database is being replaced by a Wildlife Mortalities Service and that wildlife data is available by request under its data-sharing policy, so this is NEEDS_VERIFICATION, not UNAVAILABLE: ask before concluding it does not exist. Territory-level harvest trends and hunter effort surveys are PDF only, and the 1980–2014 report could not be read to confirm whether it tabulates by subzone.

datasets.authority: Government of Prince Edward Island
datasets.title: Per-unit harvest evidence (none exists)
datasets.spatialResolution: No comprehensive hunting-unit system identified
datasets.licence: Not applicable; no dataset exists to licence
datasets.limitations: A documented absence, verified rather than assumed, so it is not re-researched. Prince Edward Island's hunting summary is a regulations document whose only harvest content is a blank self-tracking log that hunters are encouraged to share voluntarily after the season. The provincial open-data portal returns no hunting, harvest or wildlife dataset. There is no management-unit system to key evidence to.

datasets.authority: Government of the Northwest Territories, Environment and Climate Change
datasets.title: Northwest Territories harvest evidence (licence-blocked)
datasets.spatialResolution: Region, herd or subpopulation; no hunting-unit grid
datasets.licence: Crown copyright; commercial use prohibited without written permission
datasets.limitations: Material may not be used or reproduced for commercial purposes without the prior written consent of the Government of the Northwest Territories. Its 30-year Mackenzie Mountains series carries animals seen per hunter day, but region-wide only and for outfitted non-resident hunters only, so it would not answer a per-unit question even if the licence allowed it. Harvesting here also sits largely under land-claim agreements and co-management boards, a different legal context that North Ground does not model.

datasets.authority: Government of Nunavut, Department of Environment
datasets.title: Nunavut harvest evidence (licence-blocked)
datasets.spatialResolution: Region, herd or subpopulation; no hunting-unit grid
datasets.licence: Crown copyright; commercial use prohibited without written permission
datasets.limitations: Reproduction of multiple copies for commercial redistribution is prohibited without written permission from the Government of Nunavut. Nunavut publishes abundance surveys by herd, island or subpopulation, not by a hunting-unit grid, and realised harvest appears only inside Nunavut Wildlife Management Board decisions as Total Allowable Harvest, which is a management decision rather than an evidence series. Harvesting here also sits largely under land-claim agreements and co-management boards, a different legal context that North Ground does not model.
